chapters.title: The Foundations of Psychological Science & Research Methods
chapters.description: Discover how psychologists use empirical inquiry, falsifiability, and operational definitions to move from everyday intuition to rigorous scientific discovery.

chapters.title: Ethical Principles & Human Participant Protections
chapters.description: Examine historical controversies, Belmont Report pillars, Institutional Review Boards (IRBs), informed consent, deception protocols, and animal welfare.

chapters.title: Variables, Measurement & Psychometric Validity
chapters.description: Master independent and dependent variables, confounding factors, NOIR measurement scales, and the vital dimensions of reliability and construct validity.

chapters.title: Observational, Descriptive & Qualitative Methodologies
chapters.description: Explore naturalistic and structured observation, participant reactivity, observer bias, single case study investigations, archival data, and thematic coding.

chapters.title: Survey Research & Correlational Designs
chapters.description: Design unbiased survey items, understand sampling methods, interpret correlation coefficients, and navigate the directionality and third-variable dilemmas.

chapters.title: Experimental Design & Threats to Internal Validity
chapters.description: Unpack the gold standard of causal inference: random assignment, between-subjects and within-subjects designs, counterbalancing, and internal validity threats.

chapters.title: Complex Factorial Designs & Quasi-Experiments
chapters.description: Investigate multi-variable factorial experiments, main effects and interactions, non-equivalent control groups, interrupted time series, and small-N reversal designs.

chapters.title: Statistical Inference & The Replication Crisis in Psychological Science
chapters.description: Master hypothesis testing, Type I and II errors, effect size, statistical power, p-hacking pitfalls, and modern open science practices like preregistration.
